caption: Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.

observations.R13C: Eight sampled frames show nearly unchanged hands and dough; the requested shaping process is not demonstrated.
observations.R13C_no_c: Hands press, move and reposition the dough visibly. The same own400 checkpoint with physical modulation bypassed has more of the requested shaping action.
observations.R13C_key_modulation_off: Keeping Q modulation alone restores visible hand pressing and some dough deformation, but less action than no_c.
observations.R13C_query_modulation_off: Previously inspected panel remains nearly static, like normal.
observations.score_limitation: Normal, no_c, Q-only and K-only all receive SA4/PC5. These ordinal ratings miss the visibly different action execution in this case.

inference_intervention_scope: Same own400 checkpoint and verified common first-image pixels, caption, seed/noise, gamma and sampler. Historical-reference weights differ.
limitations: Sampled-frame diagnostic, not an aggregate quality score. No measured attention-to-first-frame attribution. More motion alone is not physical correctness. Numerical paired controls cover16 cases.
